steps.start: the intersection of Cranby Creek and the Gillies Bay Highway
steps.quote: Commencing at the intersection of Cranby Creek and the Gillies Bay Highway

steps.until: the mean low water mark on the natural boundary of Gillies Bay
steps.quote: thence due southwest along a line through the Gillies Bay water tower to the mean low water mark on the natural boundary of Gillies Bay

steps.until: the most southerly point of the north end of Gillies Bay
steps.quote: thence southeasterly along the low water mark to the most southerly point of the north end of Gillies Bay

steps.until: the most westerly point on the mean low water mark of the natural boundary of Dick Island
steps.quote: thence more or less south in a straight line to the most westerly point on the mean low water mark of the natural boundary of Dick Island
thence in a general southerly, easterly and northerly direction along the mean low water mark on the natural boundary of Dick Island to most easterly point thereof

steps.until: a point on the mean low water mark of the natural boundary of Gillies Bay due West of the west end of Shelter Point Road
steps.quote: thence more or less west in a straight line to a point on the mean low water mark of the natural boundary of Gillies Bay due West of the west end of Shelter Point Road

steps.until: a point 700 metres east of the junction of the Gillies Bay Highway and Shelter Point Road
steps.quote: thence along the northern boundary of the Shelter Point Road right of way to a point 700 metres east of the junction of the Gillies Bay Highway and Shelter Point Road

steps.until: a point due East of the intersection of Cranby Creek and the Gillies Bay Highway
steps.quote: thence northerly and northeasterly along a line parallel to and 700 metres perpendicular to the Gillies Bay Highway to a point due East of the intersection of Cranby Creek and the Gillies Bay Highway
thence due West to the point of commencement
